source_refs.note: Exercise 13.1, Question 12 (book page 248, PDF 253); answer key PDF 310-311.

blocks.prompt: 12 The outdoor temperature (in \(^{\circ}\)C) over time is modeled by: \(T(t) = -t^2 + 12t + 10\), where \(t\) is the time in hours. Find the instantaneous rate of change at \(t = 2\).
blocks.explanation:
"Instantaneous rate of change" ka matlab: bilkul \(t = 2\) ghante wale lamhe par temperature kitni tezi se badal raha hai. Yeh derivative \(T'(2)\) hai.
Plan: \(t = 2\) par first principle: \(T(2 + \delta t)\) kholein, \(T(2)\) minus, \(\delta t\) se divide, limit. Phir unit (\(^{\circ}\)C per hour) aur sign ka matlab samjhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(T(t) = -t^2 + 12t + 10\), \(t_1 = 2\) ghante.
Find karna hai: \(T'(2)\).
Tareeqa: \(T'(2) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0}\frac{T(2 + \delta t) - T(2)}{\delta t}\) (derivative ko instantaneous rate of change ke taur par, Section 13.2), first principle se. Bohat chhote waqt mein temperature ka farq, us waqt se divide, aur waqt zero ki taraf.

\(T(2)\) aur \(T(2 + \delta t)\) nikalein
\[T(2) = -4 + 24 + 10 = 30\]
\[T(2 + \delta t) = -(2 + \delta t)^2 + 12(2 + \delta t) + 10\]
\[= -4 - 4\,\delta t - (\delta t)^2 + 24 + 12\,\delta t + 10\]
\[= 30 + 8\,\delta t - (\delta t)^2\]
Kyun: \((2 + \delta t)^2\) khola aur minus sign teeno terms par lagaya; yahi jagah hai jahan bachche aksar sirf pehli term ko minus karte hain. Phir \(\delta t\) ki terms jama kiin: \(-4 + 12 = 8\).

Minus karein aur \(\delta t\) se divide
\[T(2 + \delta t) - T(2) = 8\,\delta t - (\delta t)^2\]
\[\dfrac{T(2 + \delta t) - T(2)}{\delta t} = 8 - \delta t\]
Kyun: \(30\) cancel hua, phir har term se ek \(\delta t\) cancel kiya.

Limit lein
\[T'(2) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0}(8 - \delta t) = 8\]
Kyun: \(\delta t = 0\) rakha to \(8\) bacha. Temperature (\(^{\circ}\)C) ko waqt (ghante) se divide kiya, is liye unit \(^{\circ}\)C per hour hai.

Matlab aur tasdeeq
\[T'(t) = -2t + 12\]
\[T'(2) = -4 + 12 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab positive hai, matlab \(t = 2\) par temperature barh raha hai, taqreeban \(8^{\circ}\)C fi ghanta ki raftaar se. General derivative \(-2t + 12\) se bhi \(8\) aaya, aur answer key bhi \(8^{\circ}\)C/hr deti hai.
